dedupe_keys.name: dsk sfc stock flow consistent agent based integrated assessment model dystopian schumpeter meeting keynes

description: DSK-SFC is an updated, stock-flow consistent version of the Dystopian Schumpeter meeting Keynes agent-based integrated assessment model, which links a simulated economy of interacting agents with the climate. Embedding the model in a fully specified accounting system means all balance sheet items and financial flows are tracked consistently through a simulation, improving analysis of the systemic effects of climate change and climate policy scenarios on the economy and on financial stability. The paper gives the most detailed description yet of a model in the Keynes plus Schumpeter family, discusses calibration and validation and presents example scenarios. It was written by Severin Reissl, Luca Fierro, Francesco Lamperti and Andrea Roventini and published on 25 March 2024 as LEM working paper 2024/09 of the Sant'Anna School of Advanced Studies in Pisa. The abstract does not tie it to one country. The working paper is listed as a free download without restriction, but the PDF could not be read from the cloud, so this record rests on the RePEc record, and code availability is unknown. Caveats: agent-based macro models have many parameters, and results depend on calibration. For simulation it links climate damages, energy transition and financial stability, useful for scenarios where physical risks to industry and infrastructure spread through credit markets. It is related to the ECB investment fund contagion model record in this catalogue.
